simple.summary: כַּרְכֹּב (karkôb) means a rim or top margin First listed occurrence: Exod 27 5.

definitions.full: H3749. karkob כַּרְכֹּב noun [masculine] border, rim , of altar (Late Hebrew id. ); — construct ׳כ הַמִּזְבֵּחַ Exod 27:5 ; with suffix כַּרְכֻּבּוֺ 38:4 (both P).
